scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

reuse.decision: retain existing Rust dump producer and format; port only shell/Expect PTY orchestration; no BFD/ELF parser introduced

reference_semantics: uname -r runs before CLI validation and its status is ignored; stdout trailing LFs stripped
exactly the first three positional arguments affect validation; an empty third permits later extra arguments
missing/empty input/output or nonempty third -> usage on stderr and1
nonregular/missing input -> input path plus : not found on stderr and1
empty configured ARCH -> ARCH_NAME is empty. on stdout and1
x86_64 maps module suffix to x86; other configured ARCH retained
export VMLINUX, INSTALLDIR, INFILE, OUTFILE to crash session
five prompt-driven commands: mod, extend, ldump2mcdump0-o, extend-u,quit
original checks only output file existence and ignores crash/Expect status, allowing stale/partial false success
valid_profile: Linux, configured literal installation paths and ordinary literal input/output paths; actual crash/extension artifacts matched; 300-second production prompt deadline; current x86_64 supported path mapped to x86
wrapper_implementation: 215-line Rust std wrapper using baseline libc openpty/setsid/ioctl/poll/kill and existing crash executable. No custom shell or Tcl runtime body. Streams forwarded over PTY; no dump format interpreted or modified.

predicate: exact path-bound success marker from matching reviewed converter delta
fresh staging file has same owned identity, is regular and nonempty
intended_behavior_change.publication: staging file in same parent; pre-existing output untouched until commit; previous regular permission bits copied on success; failed owned staging file retained separately for evidence
intended_behavior_change.failure: return1, existing final failure line, additional cause/staging diagnostics; pre-existing bytes preserved
intended_behavior_change.format_validity: delegate to the matched existing converter success contract; wrapper freshness/nonempty test is not an independent format validator or native conversion proof
intended_behavior_change.reference_comparison: preserve original observed false success separately; never count deliberately corrected status/file-disposition behavior as parity

converter_delta.status: private source proposal only; no canonical changes/compiler/fixture/native acceptance
converter_delta.conditions: all required metadata/payload reads checked, existing BFD write failures return before marker, missing physchunks suppresses marker, bfd_close succeeds before marker
converter_delta.original_observations: retain existing physical readmem error and continued later reads/writes; suppress marker on any such failure
converter_delta.prerequisite: unmodified producer has no marker, so strict wrapper cannot be shipped against it as working default

profile.process_ownership: unprivileged helper child-subreaper, per-command groups, and /proc self-children joins cover PTY peers creating separate sessions

classes: Rust PTY synthetic-peer protocol contract, success/freshness/status/preservation/error cases
separate observed stale-output success when real Expect is absent
optional real Expect original-driver observations with only crash path and timeout fixture literal bindings
fixture.synthetic_payload: not a real dump file; no format validity/native acceptance from stub bytes or fake ack

reference_prerequisites.meaning: real prerequisites absent; no replacement Tcl parser is written; --with-reference-protocol requires actual platform Expect and a separately granted attempt

fixture.retention: existing fixture-output refused; stdout/stderr, command lists/envs, process/PTY traces, old/new bytes and partial staging files retained; no automatic retries

substantive_remaining_gaps: root must review/adopt the deliberate false-success correction and atomic output contract
wrapper Rust compile/link and PTY/prompt/status fixture are unrun; framing/log_user bytes and terminal settings are unproven against platform Expect
separate converter delta needs whole-command fault/ABI fixture, production object and matched extension proof; existing pure helper smoke alone is insufficient
actual crash, matching vmlinux/module/extension and real vmcore needed for native conversion/unchanged-format acceptance
nonliteral shell/Tcl path behavior, symlink/output ownership metadata and stream/locale edge behavior remain explicit scope review, not silently equivalent
checks_run: Python AST parsing for four fixture source files
two bounded original source snapshots/pins match current canonical bytes
private diff generation from retained converter source
controller: Root owns grants, publication and canonical integration; this package is private source readiness only.
